title: Semantic Search Optimization for Technical Documentation
business: Technical support teams managing large, fragmented knowledge bases.
problem: Users struggle to find relevant help articles because traditional keyword-based search fails to capture the intent or conceptual relationships between technical documents.
solution: The gemini-embedding-001 model generates high-dimensional vector representations of text, enabling semantic search that retrieves documents based on conceptual similarity rather than exact keyword matches.
steps: Pre-process the knowledge base by chunking long technical articles into smaller, contextually relevant segments.
Pass each text chunk through the gemini-embedding-001 API to generate a high-dimensional vector representation.
Store the resulting vectors in a vector database alongside the original text metadata.
At query time, convert the user's natural language question into a vector using the same embedding model.
Perform a nearest-neighbor search in the vector database to retrieve the most semantically relevant document chunks.
outcome: Improved retrieval accuracy for complex user queries, leading to higher self-service resolution rates.
limitation: The model produces static vector representations; if the underlying technical documentation changes frequently, the stored vectors must be re-indexed to maintain search relevance.
